title: New Year and Three Musketeers
statementMd:
Do you know the story about the three musketeers? Anyway, you must help them now.

Richelimakieu is a cardinal in the city of Bearis. He found three brave warriors and called them the three musketeers. Athos has strength $*a*$, Borthos strength $*b*$, and Caramis has strength $*c*$.

The year 2015 is almost over and there are still $*n*$ criminals to be defeated. The $*i*$-th criminal has strength $*t*_{*i*}$. It's hard to defeat strong criminals — maybe musketeers will have to fight together to achieve it.

Richelimakieu will coordinate musketeers' actions. In each hour each musketeer can either do nothing or be assigned to one criminal. Two or three musketeers can be assigned to the same criminal and then their strengths are summed up. A criminal can be defeated in exactly one hour (also if two or three musketeers fight him). Richelimakieu can't allow the situation where a criminal has strength bigger than the sum of strengths of musketeers fighting him — a criminal would win then!

In other words, there are three ways to defeat a criminal.

- A musketeer of the strength $*x*$ in one hour can defeat a criminal of the strength not greater than $*x*$. So, for example Athos in one hour can defeat criminal $*i*$ only if $*t*_{*i*} ≤ *a*$.
- Two musketeers can fight together and in one hour defeat a criminal of the strength not greater than the sum of strengths of these two musketeers. So, for example Athos and Caramis in one hour can defeat criminal $*i*$ only if $*t*_{*i*} ≤ *a* + *c*$. Note that the third remaining musketeer can either do nothing or fight some other criminal.
- Similarly, all three musketeers can fight together and in one hour defeat a criminal of the strength not greater than the sum of musketeers' strengths, i.e. $*t*_{*i*} ≤ *a* + *b* + *c*$.

Richelimakieu doesn't want musketeers to fight during the New Year's Eve. Thus, he must coordinate their actions in order to minimize the number of hours till all criminals will be defeated.

Find the minimum number of hours to defeat all criminals. If musketeers can't defeat them all then print "`-1`" (without the quotes) instead.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of criminals.

The second line contains three integers $*a*$, $*b*$ and $*c*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c* ≤ 10^{8}$) — strengths of musketeers.

The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{8}$) — strengths of criminals.

## Output

Print one line with the answer.

If it's impossible to defeat all criminals, print "`-1`" (without the quotes). Otherwise, print the minimum number of hours the three musketeers will spend on defeating all criminals.

## Note

In the first sample Athos has strength $10$, Borthos $20$, and Caramis $30$. They can defeat all criminals in two hours:

- Borthos and Caramis should together fight a criminal with strength $50$. In the same hour Athos can fight one of four criminals with strength $1$.
- There are three criminals left, each with strength $1$. Each musketeer can fight one criminal in the second hour.

In the second sample all three musketeers must together fight a criminal with strength $51$. It takes one hour. In the second hour they can fight separately, each with one criminal. In the third hour one criminal is left and any of musketeers can fight him.
statementZhMd:
你知道三剑客的故事吗？不管怎样，现在你必须帮助他们。

Richelimakieu 是 Bearis 城的一名红衣主教。他找到了三名勇敢的战士，并称他们为三剑客。Athos 的力量为 $*a*$，Borthos 的力量为 $*b*$，Caramis 的力量为 $*c*$。

2015 年即将结束，但仍有 $*n*$ 名罪犯需要被击败。第 $*i*$ 名罪犯的力量为 $*t*_{*i*}$。强大的罪犯很难被击败——也许三剑客必须协同作战才能做到这一点。

Richelimakieu 将协调三剑客的行动。在每个小时内，每名剑客可以选择什么也不做，或者被安排去对付一名罪犯。两名或三名剑客可以被安排去对付同一名罪犯，此时他们的力量之和将合并计算。一名罪犯必须在恰好一个小时内被击败（即使是由两名或三名剑客共同作战）。Richelimakieu 不能允许出现罪犯的力量大于与其战斗的剑客力量之和的情况——否则罪犯将会获胜！

换句话说，有以下三种击败罪犯的方式。

- 力量为 $*x*$ 的剑客可以在一个小时内击败力量不超过 $*x*$ 的罪犯。例如，Athos 在一个小时内可以击败第 $*i*$ 名罪犯，当且仅当 $*t*_{*i*} ≤ *a*$。
- 两名剑客可以共同作战，并在一个小时内击败力量不超过这两名剑客力量之和的罪犯。例如，Athos 和 Caramis 在一个小时内可以击败第 $*i*$ 名罪犯，当且仅当 $*t*_{*i*} ≤ *a* + *c*$。注意，剩下的第三名剑客可以选择什么也不做，也可以去对付其他罪犯。
- 类似地，三名剑客可以共同作战，并在一个小时内击败力量不超过三名剑客力量之和的罪犯，即 $*t*_{*i*} ≤ *a* + *b* + *c*$。

Richelimakieu 不希望三剑客在除夕夜战斗。因此，他必须协调三剑客的行动，使击败所有罪犯所需的时间最短。

求击败所有罪犯所需的最少小时数。如果三剑客无法击败所有罪犯，则输出 "`-1`"（不含引号）。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$），表示罪犯的数量。

第二行包含三个整数 $*a*$、$*b*$ 和 $*c*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c* ≤ 10^{8}$），表示三剑客的力量。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{8}$），表示罪犯的力量。

## 输出格式

输出一行，表示答案。

如果无法击败所有罪犯，则输出 "`-1`"（不含引号）。否则，输出三剑客击败所有罪犯所需的最少小时数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Athos 的力量为 $10$，Borthos 的力量为 $20$，Caramis 的力量为 $30$。他们可以在两个小时内击败所有罪犯：

- Borthos 和 Caramis 应共同对付一名力量为 $50$ 的罪犯。在同一个小时内，Athos 可以对付四名力量为 $1$ 的罪犯中的一名。
- 还剩下三名罪犯，他们的力量均为 $1$。每名剑客可以在第二个小时内各自对付一名罪犯。

在第二个样例中，三名剑客必须共同对付一名力量为 $51$ 的罪犯。这需要一个小时。在第二个小时内，他们可以分开行动，每人对付一名罪犯。第三个小时还剩下一名罪犯，任意一名剑客都可以对付他。
